sql:
SELECT `region` AS `region`, `category` AS `category`, sum(`revenue`) AS `SUM(revenue)` 
FROM `dm`.`sales_wide` GROUP BY `region`, `category`
 LIMIT 1000

SELECT toMonday(toDateTime(`date`)) AS `__timestamp`, `region` AS `region`, sum(`revenue`) AS `SUM(revenue)` 
FROM `dm`.`sales_wide` GROUP BY `region`, `__timestamp` ORDER BY `SUM(revenue)` DESC
 LIMIT 10000

SELECT `city` AS `city`, sum(`revenue`) AS `SUM(revenue)`, sum(`orders`) AS `SUM(orders)` 
FROM `dm`.`sales_wide` GROUP BY `city`
 LIMIT 100

SELECT `city` AS `city`, `region` AS `region`, sum(`revenue`) AS `SUM(revenue)`, sum(`orders`) AS `SUM(orders)`, sum(`items`) AS `SUM(items)` 
FROM `dm`.`sales_wide` GROUP BY `city`, `region`
 LIMIT 100
